serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
???: Long time no see.
You: Huh?
I can’t quite grasp what exactly appeared before me. It’s like a shadow. It is there, but at the same time it isn’t. I feel like the whole reality is about to break.
This strange silhouette should have spooked me out, but for some reason I’m calm…
You: Who are you?
???: How is your life going?
You: Fine, I guess? 
???: That’s good to hear…
???: Did you finally find a girlfriend?
You: What’s up with those questions?! Who or what are you?!
???: Come on, now. Let’s just have a talk. It’s been a long time, we have some catching up to do.
You: No idea what’s your deal, but fine, I will answer…
You: Yeah, I have a girlfriend or someone close to it, I guess. It’s a little complicated. 
???: That’s good. Good. 
???: Now to the important thing. 
???: You need to talk to your mom more.
You: Really? Who are you to tell me that? You know nothing!
???: I know she is the way she is, but she’s still your mom.
You: Just spare me the sermon already. Can we end this?
???: You can’t blame her for what happened to me. 
You: Why are you ignoring me…
I’m getting more annoyed by the second. I don’t like this. For some reason I grow restless.
???: It’s not her fault I forgot about the pills.
You: W-What? 
???: I was a grown-ass man, it wasn’t her responsibility to check up on me. 
You: W-Who are you?! How do you know that?!
???: I’m sorry that I died so soon, son. You need to let it go. Go visit your mom. She misses you.
You: Dad?!
???: Goodbye son.
